properties.title: BRP Gewaspercelen 2022
properties.description: Definitive crop parcel registration for 2022. The BRP is an annual snapshot reflecting what farmers register each May 15 (the CAP deadline); this 'definitief' edition is finalized after verification. Published by RVO via PDOK.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Feature ID. Matches the source GeoPackage.

table:columns.name: category
table:columns.description: Broad crop category (e.g. Grasland, Bouwland, Landschapselement, Natuurterrein, Braakland, Overige). Note: Landschapselement was added in 2023; absent in this year.

table:columns.name: gewas
table:columns.description: Specific crop name (e.g. Grasland blijvend, Aardappelen consumptie, Mais snij-).

table:columns.name: gewascode
table:columns.description: Numeric crop code identifying the specific crop type.

table:columns.name: status
table:columns.description: Registration status — always 'Definitief' in this collection.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Parcel boundary polygon in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New), WKB-encoded.

data.title: BRP Gewaspercelen 2022 (GeoParquet)
data.description: 758,504 agricultural parcel polygons for the 2022 BRP definitive edition. EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New), zstd-compressed, sorted by bbox per OGC Best Practices for Distributing GeoParquet.

source.title: Source GeoPackage (PDOK definitive 2022)
source.description: Original GeoPackage download from PDOK, used to derive the GeoParquet and PMTiles for 2022. EPSG:28992. **No schema transformation** — the GeoParquet columns are byte-equivalent to the GPKG.

styles/default.title: Default (2022)
styles/default.description: Agricultural landscape — green for grassland, yellow for arable. Points at ./brp_gewaspercelen_2022.pmtiles. Generated from the canonical base style in ../styles/ via ../scripts/regen_year_styles.py.

styles/by-category.description: Distinct colors for each broad crop category. Points at ./brp_gewaspercelen_2022.pmtiles. Generated from the canonical base style in ../styles/ via ../scripts/regen_year_styles.py.
